guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Outlook
section: For the full-year, the Company is updating its outlook, projecting Adjusted revenue growth of 28 - 29%, Adjusted EBITDA growth of 29 - 30% and Adjusted EPS growth of 1.2 - 2.4%. On a Pro Forma basis, revenue is projected to grow 3.1 - 3.6% and Adjusted EBITDA is projected to grow 2.9 - 3.6%2. Additionally, the Company is maintaining its target for Free Cash Flow1 of $2.15 - $2.25 billion, or growth of 33 - 39% as compared to the prior year.

($ millions, except share data) | FY 2026
Revenue | $13,445 - $13,505
Adjusted EBITDA (Non-GAAP)2 | $5,565 - $5,605
Adjusted EPS (Non-GAAP)2 | $5.82 - $5.89
1Our 2026 Free Cash Flow outlook is defined as Free cash flow excluding cash transaction taxes on business dispositions, primarily the Worldpay sale.
